description.value: The Black Antler is an independent restaurant and bar in downtown Penticton, run by husband-and-wife team Dan and Lynn, who relocated from elsewhere in the Okanagan to fulfil a lifelong dream. The operation includes a microbrewery producing its own Antler lager, and the couple also runs a companion restaurant called The Forest next door. A touring cyclist passing through Penticton will find a locally owned spot with a full bar, weekend brunch, and a personal backstory that sets it apart from chain dining.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms an active restaurant/bar with happy hour specials, weekend brunch, and digital gift cards, indicating the business is currently operating. OSM tags (bar=yes, microbrewery=yes) are corroborated by the website's mention of house 'Antler lager.' A notable address discrepancy exists: OSM records 218 Winnipeg Street while the website consistently lists 215 Winnipeg St across all subpages; the website value is used per rule 12. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, takeout, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Address mismatch: OSM records 218 Winnipeg Street, but the website consistently lists 215 Winnipeg St across all subpages. Website value used; OSM may need correction.
